coordinate_policy: PAAD feed explicitly declares EPSG:4326; geometry coordinates agree with numeric longitude/latitude attributes.
catalog_completeness_status: 45 published dune-field records; useful for aeolian documentation context but not a comprehensive all-environment inventory.
proximity_policy: Great-circle point-to-point center distance on a 6371 km sphere; 25/100 km are review diagnostics, not site identity or novelty thresholds.
limitations: Catalog is not exhaustive and points may represent large or vaguely located regions.
A nearby catalog point does not prove the candidate is the same field site; a distant one does not prove novelty.
Catalog entries are prior-documentation context, not ground-truth analog labels for this target/profile.
The source feed is snapshotted at retrieval time; no current site condition or access verification is implied.

properties.Descriptio: Located at the northwestern edge of the region influenced by the East Asian Monsoon, near the lower reaches of the Heihe River. Second largest area of shifting sands in China.
properties.Sand_sourc: Originated in alluvial deposits of the Heihe River west of the sand sea (a).
properties.References: a: Dong et al. (2013) Investigation of the sand sea with the tallest dunes on Earth: China's Badain Jaran Sand Sea. Earth-Science Reviews, v. 120, pg. 20-39.

properties.Descriptio: Located on the Alxa Plateau in north-central China, within a wide dry valley formed by an ancient river.
properties.Sand_sourc: From an ancient river that carved the valley the dunes are located in (river estimated to date back to 10,000 yrs. ago) (a).
properties.References: a: Yao et al (2007) Migration of sand dunes on the northern Alxa Plateau, Inner Mongolia, China. Journal of Arid Environments v. 70, pg. 80-93.

properties.Descriptio: Located on the northern edge of the Kumtagh Sand Sea, northwest China.
properties.Dune_type: B, L, MR, CL, G, Y
properties.Sand_sourc: Beishan Mountain piedmont, alluvial-diluvial materials and denudation products (a).
properties.References: a: Yang et al 2021, Migration of barchan dunes and factors that influence migration in the Sanlongsha dune field of the northern Kumtagh Sand Sea, China. Geomorphology, v. 378.

properties.Descriptio: Area is northeast of Dyngjujökull and is bordered to the north by the Askja volcano and to the east by the major glacial drainage system of the Jökulsá á Fjöllum and by the Vaðalda shield volcano.
properties.Sand_sourc: Primary source is Dyngjujökull (outlet glacier). In summer, ablation of the glacier feeds a number of outlet streams. Due to percolation, downstream transmission losses occur and results in the accumulation of sand available for aeolian transport at the
properties.Sand_chara: Dominated by glass grains (80-90%). Remaining fractions corresponds to a few percent of olivine, pyroxene, and plagioclase. Overall, glass grains comprise ~80% of sand and crystalline phases ~20% (a).
properties.References: a: Baratoux et al. (2011) Volcanic sands of Iceland: Diverse origins of aeolian sand deposits revealed at Dyngjusandur and Lambahraun. Earth Surface Processes and Landforms, v. 36, no. 13, pg. 1789-1808.
